load_omnivore_model: load an Omnivore model from torch hub with configurable input type and device placement
wrap_model_forward: wrap an Omnivore model to accept video tensor input and return feature embeddings
get_video_transform: get a composed transform pipeline for normalizing, scaling, and cropping video inputs
configure_model_config: configure ModelConfig dataclass with model name, input type, side size, crop size, mean, and std
patch_final_layer: patch the Omnivore model final layer to return raw features instead of classification logits
